title: Standard Operating Procedure: Kuntai Die Cutting Operation Procedures

steps.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Kuntai Die Cutting Operation Procedures
steps.description:
Standard Operating Procedure: Kuntai Die Cutting Operation Procedures
Purpose: These operating procedures are intended for the use by operators responsible for the Kuntai die cutting press.
Definition: "Kuntai" is the manufacturing company of the cutting press. This press is classified as a "roll to die cut" machine.
Definition: Die Board - Is the board with the cutting blades imbedded into the board.
Responsibilities: Machine Operator
Die installation and adjustment when applicable
Maintaining Tools
All control panel operations
Responsible for achieving machine efficiency rates.
Loading material into the machine.
Identifying proper material from machine schedule.
Recording production results into the tablet provided.
Tablet entries include: runtime, material usage (W I P and dunnage), and finished good piece counts.
Responsibilities: Quality Inspector
It is the inspector's responsibility to check all parts as defined in the QC Check point of the Part Specification Sheet and to NOTIFY the machine operator if a quality issue exists.
The operator will be producing at the defined production rate for the machine, and it is the inspector's responsibility to remove parts from the Machine Operator's area so the Operator can run at the defined rate.
THE OPERATOR IS NOT TO SLOW TO THE RATE OF THE INSPECTOR.
Responsibilities: Team Leaders
Make sure that Machine Operators are properly trained on the equipment.
Coordinate 5 S activities.
Request maintenance repairs to equipment through maintenance application.
Monitor machine efficiencies and act as needed when underperforming.
Responsibilities: Quality Department
Responsible for decisions in instances where defective parts are made.
Will request input from General Manager when needed.
Responsible for creating, posting, and maintaining the Part Specification Sheets.
Responsibilities: Maintenance
Supports production operations as needed.
Resolve any equipment operational issues the operator may encounter.
Machine PM's and needed repairs.
Responsibilities: Safety
Safety glasses are to always be worn.
Hands must be always kept out of the press head area.
